raw.query: WITH cohort AS (SELECT f.run_id, f.readiness, f.model, f.window_name, f.lead_s, f.p99_ms, f.feasible, d.is_current, d.superseded_by FROM provenance.current_factorial AS f JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d ON d.run_id = f.run_id WHERE d.is_current = TRUE AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND f.policy = 'forecast' AND f.quantile = 'p90' AND f.rho = 15 AND f.actuation = 'issue-time' AND f.lead_s IN (15,30,45,165) AND f.readiness IN ('warm','strict') AND f.model IN ('chronos','toto','timesfm') AND f.window_name IN ('burst1','burst3','burst4','burst5','steady24h')) SELECT COALESCE(readiness,'ALL') AS readiness, COALESCE(model,'ALL') AS model, COALESCE(window_name,'ALL') AS window_name, COUNT(*) AS cells, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_s) AS leads, MIN(p99_ms) AS min_p99_ms, MAX(p99_ms) AS max_p99_ms, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feasible) AS feasible_cells, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current AND superseded_by IS NULL) AS current_unsuperseded_cells FROM cohort GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((readiness,model,window_name),()) ORDER BY readiness, model, window_name
raw.observed: All 120 current, unsuperseded cells are feasible. Every burst1, burst3, burst4, and burst5 model/readiness breakdown has p99 min=max=588.37 ms; steady24h spans 548.363-733.643 ms.
raw.claimed: The four burst windows pinned at the 588 ms service floor; the calm day 548-734 ms.
raw.evidence: The scoped p90/rho=15 issue-time factorial matches the claim after rounding: bursts 588.37 ms and calm 548.363-733.643 ms.
